_comment: Model replies for seed 7, scenarios/late-press.json, replayed by FakeModel. Hand-written in the shape the Foundry agents must return, using only numbers from the recorded tool results in late_press_tools.json. m-0001-mo-018 plants a wrong pressure index (7.4; the tools say 6.0) that the Verifier must reject. m-0001-mo-017's Narrator never answers in time, so it falls back to a template. Moments not listed have no recorded reply: goals, cards, big chances, press switches and momentum swings then get templates, and the rest are skipped. Regenerate from a real model with --record-model (see README.md).
